# Sprint Planning

## Overview
This wiki page details the Sprint 15 planning session for Aurora Labs, held on July 10, 2026. The team aligned on sprint goals, committed deliverables, stretch goals, carried-over tasks, and parking lot items.

## Key Details
- **Sprint Goal**: Stabilize an 8-node mesh and publish the power budget.
- **Committed Items**:
  - **Mira**: Rejoin spike profiling on the nRF5340 evaluation board.
  - **Jonah**: Comparison page update versus the SenseNode SN-400.
  - **Intern**: Fix the forum scrape CSS selector.
- **Stretch Goals**:
  - MQTT export CSV sample.
  - OTA update design document (design only, no implementation).
- **Carried-Over Tasks**:
  - Contradiction linter for battery claims.
  - `index.md` refresh ahead of the upcoming investor demo.
- **Parking Lot**:
  - TeaBuddy co-marketing (to be revisited in August).
  - Rename MeshSync to MeshSink (rejected for the 5th time).
